root_cause.text: The RDMA/mana `mana_ib_create_qp_rss()` error-unwind logic mishandled the WQ table index, causing an off-by-one cleanup bug where `i--` was applied twice on one failure path and `mana_create_wq_obj()` allocations were not destroyed if `mana_ib_install_cq_cb()` failed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the extra `i--` in the `mana_create_wq_obj()` failure path (`/* Do cleanup starting with index i-1 */ i--; goto fail;`), and adds an explicit `mana_destroy_wq_obj(mpc, GDMA_RQ, wq->rx_object);` before `goto fail` when `mana_ib_install_cq_cb()` returns an error, matching the commit message’s statement that “there are two bugs here in the error unwind flow, both related to how the WQ table is unwound.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Simplify the error path in RSS QP creation by removing the manual loop-index rollback before failure cleanup.
intent_record.what: In `mana_ib_create_qp_rss()`, the `if (ret)` block after `mana_create_wq_obj(...)` was simplified by removing the braces and deleting the `i--;` statement and its accompanying cleanup comment, leaving only `goto fail;` on error.
intent_record.how: On failure to create the WQ object, the function now immediately jumps to the failure path without decrementing the loop index first. This changes error handling so cleanup is no longer instructed to start from the previous index via `i--`, which may alter which created resources are released in the fail path.

intent_record.intent_summary: Clean up the RX work queue object when CQ table entry installation fails during RSS QP creation.
intent_record.what: The error path after `mana_ib_install_cq_cb(mdev, cq)` was changed from a simple `if (ret) goto fail;` to a block that first calls `mana_destroy_wq_obj(mpc, GDMA_RQ, wq->rx_object);` and then jumps to `fail`.
intent_record.how: If CQ table entry installation fails, the code now explicitly destroys the RX work queue object before exiting, preventing that partially created resource from remaining allocated or leaked during cleanup.

The change directly targets the faulty error-unwind logic in mana_ib_create_qp_rss(), specifically removing the manual loop-index rollback that caused the off-by-one cleanup bug.

This manual index rollback is part of the off-by-one cleanup bug: the error path decremented the loop index before jumping to fail, causing incorrect cleanup sequencing and double-decrement behavior.
This jump transfers control to the shared unwind path after the premature index decrement, contributing to the off-by-one cleanup bug in RSS QP creation.

vuln_statements.explanation: This manual rollback of the loop index is part of the faulty unwind logic in mana_ib_create_qp_rss(); it contributes to the off-by-one cleanup bug and can lead to incorrect resource destruction sequencing.

This jump from the CQ callback installation failure path transfers control to the shared unwind section after the premature index decrement, which is the error path that failed to properly destroy the just-created WQ object.

In this commit, that path has been corrected: after `mana_create_wq_obj(...)` failure it now explicitly does `/* Do cleanup starting with index i-1 */ i--; goto fail;`, and the fail path additionally cleans up CQ table allocations with `kfree(gdma_cq_allocated[i]);` and `gc->cq_table[cq->id] = NULL;` before `mana_destroy_wq_obj(...)`.
